description: This file defines a service for aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) cost data by agent name from a MongoDB collection. It includes functions to resolve collection names based on environment variables, build complex MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different schema formats, and fall back to in-process aggregation if necessary. The main exported functions are 'getLlmCostByAgent' for retrieving aggregated costs and 'aggregateAgentsInApp' for in-memory aggregation.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines candidate collection names based on environment variable 'LLM_EVENTS_COLLECTION' and default list, deduplicating while prioritizing certain names.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process flat schema documents with various agent and cost fields, normalizing agent names, extracting costs, and summing totals per agent.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB pipeline to process documents with an 'Agents' array, normalizing agent names, extracting costs, and aggregating totals per agent.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-process (client-side) aggregation over an array of documents, summing agent costs while preserving display casing and normalizing agent names.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main async function exporting the logic to retrieve aggregated LLM costs by agent name from MongoDB collections, trying multiple schema pipelines, with fallback to in-memory aggregation if needed.
